passages.context: Under Monday, 3 July 2006, in the 16:30 'Forum – Funde – Fragen' block, the program identifies Otmar Nestroy of Graz and prints the complete thirty-minute contribution title 'Familiäres oder: A generatione et progenie aus dem Hause Nestroy'.
passages.notes: The source verifies speaker, title, forum setting, duration, event dates, and place. It does not identify Psalm 89, the Roman Psalter, or the Missal, and it does not state that the title is a joke.
